newsitem.title: USA: MedCath sees Q1 EPS in line with estimates.
newsitem.headline: MedCath sees Q1 EPS in line with estimates.

text.p: MedCath Inc said Tuesday it expects fiscal first quarter results to be in line with analysts' expectations of $0.15 per share.
MedCath said its first heart hospital in McAllen, Texas, was profitable in the quarter and appears to have achieved a dominant market share in the region.
In calendar 1996, McAllen Heart Hospital treated 2,330 patients in its cardiac cath laboratories, which the company estimates is about a 44 percent share of the market.
Results for the fiscal first quarter, December 31, are expected to be released on January 27.
